name: comp-364
title: User Profile Hovercard
description: A name with avatar and handle reveals a profile card on hover. The card repeats the person's photo, name and handle, adds a short bio, and shows overlapping friend avatars with a mutual-friend count.
use: Names in a feed or comment should reveal who someone is without a page load.
avoid: Hover cards need a pointer; touch users cannot open this and must tap through instead.
a11y: The trigger is a paragraph wrapping a link, so keyboard focus may not open the card; avatar alt text is generic. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small row on a dark page: a round portrait, a bold name link, and a grey handle beneath. Hovering opens a dark rounded card below with the same portrait and name, a short bio, and three overlapping small avatars beside '3 mutual friends'.
behaves: Hovering the name fades in the card below it; moving the pointer into the card keeps it open, and leaving dismisses it.
customise: The name, handle, bio, photo paths and mutual-friend count are all fixed in the file; swapping in real people means editing the source.
weight: light: A few images and a small popup; it only appears on hover.
